name: slop-skills
description: Five focused Codex skills for code cleanup, read-only review, scoped finding repair, autonomous PR review-and-fix loops, and pull request briefs.

interface.shortDescription: Clean code, review risk, fix findings, loop, and explain PRs.
interface.longDescription: Deslop applies behavior-preserving cleanup. Slopmeter performs a research-first, strictly read-only product review. Slop Fix verifies and repairs P-level findings that belong to the pull request without widening scope. Slop Loop runs those review and repair stages in a fresh matched Codex session, verifies two clean pushed passes, then runs a read-only Claude Opus 5 P-level review for final triage. Slop Brief explains pull requests in product language and keeps an authorized PR's managed brief current.
defaultPrompt: Use $slopmeter to review this PR without changing code.
Use $slop-fix to verify and repair the findings that belong to this pull request.
Use $slop-loop on this PR until two consecutive Slopmeter passes are clean, then run the read-only Claude Opus 5 review and triage its P-level findings.
Use $slop-brief to explain this pull request and keep its managed brief current.
